original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds an optional `tenantID` setting to the AzureDNS DNS01 solver's managed identity configuration, so users can specify the tenant ID; existing configurations need no changes.

decision.reason: [ev-cd466139dded] says the new optional `tenantID` option is for the AzureDNS provider when managed identities are used. The CRD validators confirm against [ev-60054fcf0986] and [ev-84061d76ea1b] that the field was added at spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID on the Issuer schema. Because the subject is fixed as the Issuer field, an Issuer with azureDNS.managedIdentity set matches the environments this addition touches. The consequence is none, so no operator work is claimed. ClusterIssuer is left out because the validation results only report the Issuer schema.
